explanation: Negation of the question at erdosproblems.com/1041: monic f of degree ≥2 with all roots in the open disc, is there a path of length <2 in {|f|<1} joining two roots? Path length is modelled by H¹ of the image, equivalent here because a path with small-H¹ image contains a simple arc whose length equals H¹. The page does not list a resolution, but its forum thread records ani's 7 Sep 2026 degree-seven counterexample and an independent Lean check; I did not verify these. Allowing z₁=z₂ for repeated roots only strengthens the negation, so the negated claim needs a squarefree counterexample, which the docstring describes.
